svg.title: Arwad, Phase 2 results
svg.desc: Times faster than R: 43.7× vs the lm() loop most researchers write; 7.4× vs the same algorithm in plain R: compilation alone; 10.8× vs the glm() loop most researchers write; 12.3× vs the same algorithm in plain R: compilation alone; 19.3× both on 4 cores, vs seminr::bootstrap_model() (its fastest of three runs); 8.8× Arwad on 1 core, vs seminr::bootstrap_model() on 4 cores (its fastest run); 15.2× 1,000 resamples on 1 core, vs the same algorithm in plain R. Results bit-identical to R and seminr.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The same answers as R, bit for bit, from native code

svg.text: Times faster on one laptop (Intel i7-7600U), same seed for every contender, identical results.

svg.text: Green: against the code researchers use today. Blue: against the same algorithm in GNU R.
